title: Judgment on the Ammonites
description: The word of the Lord came to Ezekiel concerning the Ammonites. Because they shouted with glee, "Aha!" over the disaster that struck Israel when the sanctuary was desecrated, the land of Israel laid waste, and Judah went into exile, they will be handed over as a possession to the people of the East. Rabbah shall become a pasture for camels, and the Ammonites shall be wiped out among the nations, so that they may know that I am the Lord.
